dataset: UCI Default of Credit Card Clients
permitted_research_interpretation: Retrospective predictive benchmark on the supplied historical dataset, with the source timing limitations disclosed.

evaluation_design.test_set_policy: Keep test set sealed until model and decision threshold are frozen; use once for final retrospective evaluation.
evaluation_design.random_split_limitation: Rows are partitioned randomly; this does not create a chronological or customer-history holdout.

causal_track.reason: The UCI dataset does not document customer-level credit-limit interventions, treatment timing, and a sufficiently defined post-intervention outcome.
